verdict.comment: The vote goes to FIRST LEGION who won well on his York debut before finishing runner-up in the National Stakes.

comments.afjan: Won a newcomers' race at Chantilly this month and his RPR suggests performance was useful
comments.ameeq: Won at Nottingham on 2nd start but that form leaves him with plenty to find at this level
comments.charlesdarwin: Has made all in his last two starts; not certain to get his own way but still respected
comments.clearforce: Finished just over 2l behind First Legion at Sandown three weeks ago; something to find
comments.comicalpoint: Made a winning debut at Salisbury last month but the form leaves him with a lot to find

comments.firstlegion: Won at York and runner-up in the National Stakes; stiff 5f should suit; high on the list
comments.graft: Won a Chantilly Listed race last time but has raced only on ground softer than good
comments.heytrublue: Runner-up on Leicester debut and the form has been franked; not ruled out each-way
comments.irishfighter: Runner-up on his Wolverhampton debut but unlikely to be winning this
comments.lilbrother: Second and first in two starts, but needs to improve plenty to make an impact in this
comments.londonboy: Made a winning debut at Brighton; holds a Group 1 entry; tongue-tie on
comments.navallight: Runner-up in the same Beverley race in which last year's winner made a winning debut
comments.sandalssong: Qualified for this when winning on last month's Gulfstream debut; watch market
comments.starmaterial: Has improved with each start and won at Ripon last time; will need to step up again
comments.wiseapproach: Made a winning debut over C&D before fourth behind First Legion at York

races.raceComment: graft is marginally preferred with a score of 31.7%, holding clear edges in more progressive over charlesdarwin. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. verdict.comment: Ralph Beckett can win it for the third time in five years, this time with SING US A SONG who is preferred to Gunship.

comments.ammes: 8-15, won two-runner novice at Chepstow; cheekpieces go on for demanding handicap debut
comments.boatswain: Pipped in his last two novices; strong finish last time, so 1m4f has to be well worth a go
comments.chessdad: Has run in three novice events, fourth to Masai Moon at Nottingham; granddam Oaks winner
comments.daiquiribay: Dam won at up to 2m and he shapes as if stepping up to 1m4f will suit him well
comments.grecianlegacy: Held up; nearly won both his 1m2f handicaps this term; not crying out that loudly for 1m4f
comments.gunship: Judged on his Sandown third in particular, he looks a tempting proposition for 1m4f
comments.lightasair: Eyecatching second to Serious Contender two runs back; up in trip here with cheekpieces
comments.lighteningmann: Pipped in the London Gold Cup at Newbury and it looks like 1m4f will suit him
comments.mafting: Finally got the job done at another short price but it's no great recommendation for this
comments.masaimoon: Battled back to pip Boatswain; gelded since; 1m4f for handicap debut will suit him well
comments.merchant: Up 8lb but he was impressive at York (1m4f, good to firm) and the form has been boosted
comments.nauticalforce: Four races; likely to stay but he needs to raise his game again for this handicap debut
comments.omniman: This handicap debut is a very different scenario but he's getting the hang of things
comments.pantilewarrior: Stays but he needs to find more and faces a ton of rivals who are far less exposed
comments.propose: 1m2f maiden winner; brings clear potential, plus probable stamina, to this handicap debut
comments.seriouscontender: Two from four; won 16-runner handicap at Leopardstown (1m2f, good) from Light As Air
comments.singusasong: Clearcut win at Sandown (1m2f, good; made most); changed hands since; 1m4f will suit
comments.thecursor: Well-bred maiden; last of seven in Epsom Listed race; unexposed but also plenty to prove
comments.waterfordflow: Needs to show something new on this handicap debut; not so stoutly bred as some of these

comments.coltrane: 2nd and 5th in last two Gold Cups but others will have to underperform if he's to win it

comments.illinois: Classy galloper over shorter; no surprise if he's another Gold Cup winner for his yard

comments.insidematters: Well connected; off since winning 7f maiden in France last July; easier options later

comments.ramazan: Minor form this year but 9lb lower than close 2nd in Victoria Cup over C&D in May 2024

comments.thunderball: Capable at 1m/1m1f for the Coles but up against it for new yard after layoff

verdict.comment: Perhaps EARLY MORNING DEW will be able to notch a third C&D win, with Megan Jordan an obvious bonus, but no outcome would surprise.

comments.apachecanyon: Poor in two starts for this yard; best efforts have come on Tapeta; not obviously fancied
comments.bohemianbreeze: Expensive to follow for two yards in the past year; can pull hard; cheekpieces return
comments.earlymorningdew: Dual C&D winner from four runs; has one of the more experienced jockeys up; player
comments.enthused: Typically failed to back up his Brighton near-miss when well held last Thursday; capable
comments.francesi: On a long losing run; well treated now but others are more persuasive
comments.mrnugget: Pulled hard last time and will want a good test down from 1m4f, which isn't certain
comments.palazzopersico: Currently 2-5 over C&D, latterly off a 5lb higher mark last winter; couldn't be ruled out

races.raceComment: earlymorningdew is marginally preferred with a score of 45.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more reliable profile over enthused. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Crimson Rose is the most interesting newcomer and COMING ATTRACTION sets the standard she's gunning for.

comments.comingattraction: Made a promising debut at Goodwood (6f) late last month; sets a decent standard
comments.crimsonrose: Early-foaled first offspring of a French 5f Group 3 winner; likely looking newcomer
comments.harlequinangel: Rather in at the deep end on debut but it would be a surprise to see her feature
comments.laurasia: First foal of an unraced mare (stamina in her pedigree); worth a market check
comments.lookslikely: Trainer enjoyed a decent season thus far with 2yos and the market will guide
comments.moodeng: Well-beaten last of six on her Newmarket debut, when the occasion got the better of her
comments.welcomeretreat: Like stablemate Laurasia has stamina in her pedigree and she too is probably best watched
comments.yellowdiamonds: 170,000gns breeze-up purchase; still looked work in progress latest and can improve again

races.raceComment: comingattraction is marginally preferred with a score of 21.8%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over yellowdiamonds. verdict.comment: Fidelius makes marginally most appeal of three Cowell runners, but strong-travelling MOULIN BOOJ should get this run to suit.

comments.blazesboylan: Dual C&D winner from the front; will need a career-best to take this back from a break
comments.fidelius: 2-2 over C&D, having won his novice last spring and a handicap off 7lb lower in March
comments.jungleland: Having a first crack at 5f having run over 7f last time; this much more about raw speed
comments.moulinbooj: Poor strike-rate in recent times but he is consistent and remains capable off this mark
comments.sevensees: Ordinary debut for his new yard, without the tongue-tie, at Southwell a few weeks ago
comments.ziggysmissile: Four-time Tapeta winner who's only run once on Polytrack; little wiggle room off this mark

races.raceComment: moulinbooj is marginally preferred with a score of 52.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings over fidelius. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Close to the pace throughout when close fourth in a good York handicap on Saturday, TELE RED (nap) gets the verdict off the same mark.

comments.chuzzlewit: Kept on steadily for fifth on recent stable debut and can build on that performance here
comments.cosmosraj: Went close at York (1m1f) on Saturday and contests this easier race from the same mark
comments.electricavenue: Ready winner at Redcar this month; up in grade here but evidently in good nick
comments.finnironside: Game winner off this mark at York (7f) last summer; makes stable debut after a layoff
comments.jezbomb: Has remained in good form since win in April but needs to find hidden reserves today
comments.kalamunda: 5-11 on AW; 0-8 on turf but could be well handicapped on this surface
comments.paladin: Ended 2024 with AW win but absent since; others look better handicapped
comments.reidh: Yet to hit strike form this season but lurks on a dangerous mark; can't be ruled out
comments.telered: Makes quick reappearance after close fourth at York on Saturday; good chance
comments.triggerman: Both runs last month were perfectly respectable but others in this line-up appeal more
comments.withoutcompromise: Well handicapped on middle-distance AW form; well beaten over 1m on recent turf debut
comments.yaajooz: Good second at Thirsk last month, and subsequent York defeat is forgivable

races.raceComment: cosmosraj is marginally preferred with a score of 56.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over jezbomb. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 5 wins from 22 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

form.rpCloseUpComment: held up in rear, not clear run over 1f out, no impression (jockey was questioned regarding his riding of gelding over final 2f after reporting at scales that he had been denied a clear run in home straight; jockey was questioned specifically as to why he had appeared not to make greater effort to improve his position and obtain a run that existed between rivals for some distance approaching final furlong; in explaining his riding jockey indicated that due to his positioning down the inner at rear of field, he had made the decision from leaving back straight to ride for luck and search for inside runs rather than potentially be forced extremely wide when mounting his challenge; he continued by saying that he wanted to be certain that the run which presented itself shortly after straightening for home remained open as he was conscious that a rival in front of him had set a solid pace and was giving ground, whilst that rival was also under pressure to his outside and his rider had whip in his right-hand; for this reason he had been reluctant to fully commit gelding into a gap which in all likelihood would close; however he was nudging gelding along and keeping the revs up at same time before, as he had anticipated passing 1f marker, gelding was denied a clear run between rivals and had to check off heels; he added that there were two factors behind his thinking in not committing for what he considered to be a low percentage gap, firstly that gelding was dropping back in trip and is not known for having a turn of acceleration and secondly that he had suffered a very heavy fall on the all-weather in October 2024 and considered that by putting gelding into a narrowing gap, which it would not have the pace to necessarily quicken through before it closed, would present a heightened opportunity for him to suffer serious interference)

comments.galileoscompass: Has dropped a long way in weights but he's 0-11 and has a very patchy profile; opposable
comments.masterofgreygoose: 0-10 and he needs this step back up in trip to make a difference; cheekpieces added

comments.kessaarpower: Good run behind a handicap blot at Chelmsford last week (1m); contender at this level

comments.vitalline: Running creditably in better company this year; high on the list dropped into a 0-50

verdict.comment: The handicap newcomers Dubai Treasure and Ultrasoul need a close look but slight preference is for WHITE CROWN STAR.

comments.auroramajesty: Well held last twice but he's still unexposed and could kick on again back up in trip
comments.dubaitreasure: Unexposed 4yo; back from another lengthy absence but needs a close look on handicap debut
comments.giant: Last win was 15 months ago and has mixed record this year; others are more convincing
comments.habrdi: On dangerous mark but has lots to prove and he needs a big turnaround
comments.majesticwave: Well held in his last three runs and he's now 1-9; others preferred
comments.mastertechnician: His form has cooled in last two starts and needs to get back near best
comments.reydelabatalla: Dual C&D winner and has possibilities off workable mark back on AW
comments.threatening: Still lightly raced but didn't fire here last time and needs to step up again after that
comments.ultrasoul: Placed in three of his four 2yo runs and he needs a close look on handicap/AW debut
comments.whitecrownstar: Won at Kempton in March and he's been placed in three handicaps since; respected

races.raceComment: mastertechnician is marginally preferred with a score of 57.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over reydelabatalla. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Excellent course form of 3/11 at lingfield. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
